liveRecord.approval: Owner approved the live microphone test and was at the phone (A1: recording is ask-first). Quiet library; owner spoke softly.
liveRecord.command: ssh phone 'proot-distro login debian -- phone-transcribe --json --record 8 --keep /data/data/com.termux/files/home/a8rec', then phone-transcribe --json -m small.en on the kept clip

earlierTakes: --keep /tmp/a8rec: recording failed, file empty. Termux:API writes the file, so --keep must be a path Termux can reach (Termux home), not the Debian /tmp. Microphone permission was granted.

--record 5, three takes: [BLANK_AUDIO]; 'Open Turmux.'; 'Open terms.' (small.en on that clip: 'Open.'). The owner could not see the SPEAK NOW prompt, which prints on the PC, and recording starts 1 to 2 s after the request, so speech was cut off. Timing, not recognition.
lessons: Cue the speaker with the phone's green microphone indicator, not the PC prompt.
Allow 3 s of slack over the sentence length (--record 8 for a 7-word command).
liveRecord.cleanup: All clips deleted from the phone after the runs (rm -rf ~/a8rec); only text left the phone.
